messages:
jamie: quick update — we launched a small canary for faststart-quant-route in ca-central-1 at 07:30. rule: first-token emission and short responses (<120 input tokens) use quant-fast-v2.

hao: quick summary numbers?

jamie: canary window 07:30-07:58 (6% traffic): requests 7.8k, p50 19ms -> 11ms (-42%), p95 235ms -> 142ms (-40%), p99 540ms -> 380ms (-30%). estimated token-cost delta ~-20%. no spike in error-rate.

deploy-bot: rollout: route-controller v1.16.2 -> canary(6%) (deploy id: d-20260314-02)

rina: did we run the short-dialogue eval set? any quality diffs?

jamie: yes — ran our short-dialogue and quick-code evals (3k samples). overall automated metrics within thresholds. found two narrow classes: monetary formatting and table alignment in markdown. added a bypass rule: if prompt contains /\|.*\|/ (table) or currency tags, route to full-precision.

syl: worth noting Dedicated customers won't see model selection changes on their pinned groups. billing unaffected. billing-bot: note posted.

hao: what are the rollback conditions and ramp plan?

jamie: auto-rollback if errors > baseline*2 for 6m OR p95 > baseline*1.7 for 5m. ramp: 6% -> 30% in 12h if stable -> 80% in 48h -> 100% in 96h. manual rollback if internal dogfood shows quality regressions.

ops-bot: alert rule added: faststart-quant/ca-central-1 p95 > baseline*1.5 -> notify @eng-oncall @eng-runtime. synthetic check added for table/currency prompts every 5m.

hhao: small nit — KV cache warmup behaviour? we saw p99 tails last month during cold-starts.

jamie: KV path unchanged. we added a limited prefetch of top-40 prefixes for this route only; memory cap applied. microbench shows warmup p99 improved ~12%.

hina: can we surface an adoption metric in Console? Product asked for a short blurb with savings estimate.

jamie: will add a Route Analytics tile with projected savings and a one-liner for the weekly update. action items: 1) extend evals for markdown tables (rina) 2) add console tile (jamie) 3) watch canary and synthetic tests (ops). :rocket:

hao: nice work. keep a close eye on the synthetic checks and escalate if anything drifts. :eyes:
